text: {"885":{"about":["rustc_mir_transform"],"refers":["rustc_middle","rustc_data_structures"],"why":"The MIR-transform query pipeline produces these intermediate stolen MIR bodies, while rustc_middle defines MIR allocation and rustc_data_structures defines Steal."},"886":{"about":["rustc_mir_transform","rustc_data_structures"],"refers":[],"why":"MIR transformation uses Steal to hand MIR between queries without cloning, and Steal implements the stealing semantics."},"887":{"about":["rustc_data_structures"],"refers":[],"why":"The panic on access after stealing is behavior implemented by the Steal container."},"888":{"about":["rustc_mir_transform"],"refers":[],"why":"This warns MIR-pipeline query authors to preserve the required dependency ordering before reading intermediate MIR."},"889":{"about":["rustc_mir_transform"],"refers":[],"why":"The ordering requirement concerns the MIR processing pipeline's ownership and consumption of phase-specific MIR."}}
